question: Which origin edge has the worst peak vs. off-peak travel time degradation ratio? Divide the simulation into fixed 300-second bins starting at 0. The peak bin is the one with the most vehicle departures (use int(depart_time) // 300). For each origin edge, compute degradation = mean_peak_duration / mean_offpeak_duration. Skip origins without both peak and off-peak vehicles. Answer format: <edge_id>
